name: Runner Extras - XmlPort Metadata Floor App
brief: Issue #4461: an app stating only the application floor still sees System Application's xmlports in XMLport Metadata.
description: Issue #4461. The XMLport Metadata app-group filter hides a compiled xmlport whose app is outside the executing group's visible closure, and that closure excludes the implicit application floor. Xmlports of a registered .app package are exempt from that rule; without the exemption every Base and System Application xmlport vanished for an app like this one, which declares no explicit dependencies. Runner-specific: app-group visibility is a runner concept.
